decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. By utilizing cards like Predict and Portent, the player can manipulate their draws and stay ahead of their opponent. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Exalted Angel and Lightning Angel to provide a threat on the board. With a mix of control elements and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own dominance on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana with various Elves, utilize cards like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote for extra value, and then overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. By ramping up mana early and using Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and win through efficient aggression. Additionally, cards like Caller of the Claw and Wellwisher provide added utility and resilience to the deck.

This deck is focused on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive Goblin creatures, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to put them into play for free and Goblin Warchief to reduce their casting cost. The deck includes disruption with cards like Naturalize to deal with opposing threats, while also providing some utility with cards like Siege-Gang Commander for additional creature removal. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, including lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and ensure a fast and efficient strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using Oath of Druids as a win condition. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's plays with Sphere of Resistance, Wraths of God, and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. It has a strong land destruction theme with cards like Dust Bowl and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also utilizes cards like Sylvan Library and Gaea's Blessing for card advantage and resilience. Overall, this deck focuses on stalling the game and utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Phantom Nishoba.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Aluren enchantment to constantly cast creatures for free, creating a loop of value and generating card advantage. By using cards like Raven Familiar, Cavern Harpy, and Wirewood Savage along with Aluren, the deck aims to set up a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents with a flurry of creatures and triggers. The deck also includes cards like Living Wish and Intuition to tutor for key pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources and slowing down their game plan through various control elements such as Winter Orb, Sphere of Resistance, and Swords to Plowshares. It aims to manipulate the opponent's hand and field with cards like Gamble, Enlightened Tutor, and Scroll Rack while also utilizing cards like Zuran Orb and Land Tax for mana advantage. The overall strategy is to outlast the opponent by maintaining board control and resource advantage until the deck can secure a win condition.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay by summoning a horde of goblins to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful goblins early, while cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator provide removal and additional damage. The deck also includes Patriarch's Bidding to bring back goblins from the graveyard for a final push. With a mix of tribal synergies and low-cost high-impact creatures, this deck aims to secure victory through sheer speed and numbers.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with efficient creatures like Rogue Elephant, Quirion Ranger, and Fyndhorn Elves, supported by pump spells like Giant Growth and Might of Oaks. Winter Orb and Tangle Wire help to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells, while also efficiently ramping up its own mana production with Llanowar Elves and Windswept Heath.

The main concept of this deck is to achieve a win condition by utilizing the combo of Balancing Act and Obliterate to reset the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. This combo can be searched for using Burning Wish. The deck also utilizes cards like Orim's Chant to protect the combo and synergistic cards like Fire / Ice to control the board. Additionally, the deck uses mana-generating artifacts and lands to ramp up quickly and enable the combo as early as possible.

This deck aims to create a streamlined combo strategy using cards like Balancing Act and Obliterate to reset the board while maintaining advantage with cards like Burning Wish and Fire/Ice. The deck utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Chromatic Sphere and Tinder Wall to quickly cast spells. The inclusion of cards like Anurid Brushhopper and Terravore provides additional threats to pressure opponents. Overall, this deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while setting up a powerful win condition to secure victory.

The deck revolves around quickly building up a strong board presence with efficient Elf creatures and leveraging the power of Gaea's Cradle to generate large amounts of mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful cards like Deranged Hermit and Survival of the Fittest to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy. The deck also includes some utility creatures like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to help protect key creatures and ensure a smooth mana curve throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize enchantments to create a powerful combo strategy. By using cards like Enchantress's Presence and Sterling Grove to draw cards and protect enchantments, along with cards like Oath of Druids and Replenish to bring back key pieces, this deck aims to quickly set up a win condition. The deck also includes ways to control the board with cards like Elephant Grass and Seal of Cleansing. With efficient mana ramping and card draw, this deck looks to outvalue and overwhelm opponents with its enchantment-based combo.

This deck focuses on using graveyard recursion and sacrificing creatures to assemble a game-winning combo. The key strategy involves using cards like Dance of the Dead, Necromancy, and Animate Dead to bring back key creatures from the graveyard, such as Gamekeeper. These creatures can then be sacrificed with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Altar of Dementia to generate value or end the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Cabal Therapy and Duress to protect the combo. Overall, the goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures, taking advantage of their synergy and tribal abilities. The deck aims to play low-cost creatures like Goblin Lackey and Mogg Fanatic early on to establish a strong board presence, while also using cards like Goblin Warchief and Goblin King to boost the power of all Goblins on the battlefield. The inclusion of burn spells like Hearth Charm and Goblin Sharpshooter helps to clear obstacles and finish off opponents. Wasteland and Barbarian Ring offer additional utility and disruption.

This Control deck focuses on using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. By utilizing a mix of white and blue cards, including Meddling Mage and Mana Leak, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and gradually establish a strong board presence with creatures like Exalted Angel and Lightning Angel. The deck also has access to burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares for additional removal options. Overall, the deck's strategy is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through careful control of the game tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through removal spells and hand disruption while also utilizing powerful creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by recurring creatures with cards like Recurring Nightmare and Volrath's Stronghold, as well as using Pernicious Deed to clear the board. The creatures in the deck are resilient and efficient, providing a strong board presence. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to colored mana sources for casting spells. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control while presenting a strong threat on the battlefield.
